train_body.message: Your body grows sturdier as physical strain tempers your foundation.

temper_flesh.message: Careful conditioning toughens your flesh without shaking your foundation.

strengthen_viscera.message: Measured breaths and heavy strain harden your inner organs.

forge_bones.message: Each impact rings through your bones and leaves them denser than before.

condense_pulses.message: Your blood and pulse settle into a steadier martial rhythm.

refine_marrow.message: A deep heat moves through your marrow and leaves your frame renewed.

open_gate.message: You test the hidden gates within your body and steady the strain.

ignite_dao_palace_star.message: A faint star-mark answers your will within the Dao Palace.

gather_essence.message: You draw spiritual energy through your meridians and settle it within your dantian.

circulate_qi.message: Your true essence circles smoothly and leaves fewer turbulent traces.

stabilise_dantian.message: You quiet the dantian until its stored essence rests without ripples.

condense_core.message: Dense essence gathers around a steady center in your dantian.

undergo_life_destruction.message: You brush against destruction and return with a sharper vessel.

expand_divine_sea.message: The sea of essence within you widens by a quiet margin.

transform_inner_world.message: Your inner world answers the rhythm of your true essence.

stabilise.message: You slow your breathing and settle the restless force in your meridians.
You calm your churning true essence and let it settle evenly through your meridians.
